verdict.rationale: IVS Real-Time documents stages with up to 12 hosts, audio rooms, and broadcast SDKs for mobile and web. Nothing in the evidence shows a server-side participant SDK or an agent joining a stage to receive live audio and publish speech back. Client-side host and guest features are adjacent, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
